svg.text: BLUE REWARDS · SYSTEMS MAP · FIGURE FOR THE PRD
Where the product sits in the system
An enhancement inside Blue Rewards, not a replacement for it
Blue Rewards sees a part of this, not the whole.
with or without a BMO banking relationship
Recorded activity is evidence of programme
Owns the programme, funds it and carries the liability.
The systems of record. The product reads them and writes back to them.
A dedicated space inside the existing app and website
Blue, the conversational assistant, works across all four with the same saved information
The product owns no system of record. It owns the member’s understanding of them.
What it creates that did not exist before
Saved goals and comparisons · ranked options with reasons · a case the member can follow
The product coordinates with them. It controls none of them.
cases routed to whoever is responsible
Underneath, value moves through the five stages on the systems map: Opportunity, Potential Value, Earned Value, Available Value, Realized Value.
The product does not move value. It changes whether the member can see, judge, follow and recover it.
WHAT THE PRODUCT DOES NOT REPLACE
• Existing earning methods: partner scans, linked-card offers, receipts, Shops and BMO products.
• Redemption fulfilment: gift cards, travel, merchandise and partner redemptions.
• BMO and partner support where manual investigation or partner action is required.
• Partner issuance, redemption and reversal: those services need partner credentials, not a member session.
